public_rationale: The evidence points toward expanding use, including independent survey growth through July 2025 and OpenAI's later report of broader adoption. It does not show the predicted collapse. However, this sentence has no definite deadline. Treating the adjacent 12-month forecast as its deadline would materially change the assessment, so this claim remains unresolved under the open-horizon rule.
limitations: The independent survey covers six countries rather than the whole world.
Adoption growth alone does not establish profitability.

statement.excerpt: The neural network approach known as generative AI — especially its poster chatbot ChatGPT – has captured the world’s imagination, but will soon flame out.
statement.document_title: AlphaProof, AlphaGeometry, ChatGPT, and why the future of AI is neurosymbolic

our_interpretation: The plain reading is a substantial, sustained collapse in adoption and commercial activity, especially for ChatGPT.
Soon expresses urgency but supplies no definite last date. The following 12-month prediction concerns when a bubble begins bursting, rather than when the predicted collapse is completed.
I do not convert the screening suggestions of one or two years into a deadline supplied by Marcus.
criteria.support_condition: Dated evidence establishes a broad, sustained collapse in generative AI adoption and commercial activity, including ChatGPT.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Continued expansion would contradict fulfillment over the period observed. Without a definite deadline, it cannot conclusively disprove eventual collapse.
